description: Unit tests in tests/test_collect.py for every new pure function introduced by FEAT-002/FEAT-003, per the design Testability list and NIT#4/NIT#6. These are the fast, AWS-free tests that lock the disintermediation invariant (contact/price exposure rules in _creq_view, chat gate in _chat_enabled) and the admin gate. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (the functions must exist). Follows the existing test file's _load() + pytest pattern and the conftest.py stubs.
steps: In tests/test_collect.py add tests for _dec_price: '5' -> Decimal('5.00')-equivalent (value 5), '1.555' rounds to 2dp, '' and junk -> None, negative -> None.

Add tests for _validate_quote(amount, max_price): None -> (False, message); Decimal('0') and negative -> (False, 'A quote amount greater than 0 is required'); amount > max_price -> (False, "Quote exceeds the owner's maximum price"); within max and no-max -> (True, None).

Add _creq_view tests: for status 'requested' AND 'accepted' with a waste object passed, assert fullAddress/ownerPhone/unlocked are ABSENT and (NIT#6) assert quoteAmount, currency, maxPrice, paymentStatus are PRESENT (never gated by unlock). For each status in UNLOCK_STATUSES ('confirmed','collected','disputed') WITH a waste object, assert unlocked is True and fullAddress/ownerPhone present. For each UNLOCK_STATUSES status WITH waste=None, assert contact fields ABSENT (documents the list_requests call-site contract). Rename test_creq_view_unlocks_when_approved to reflect 'confirmed'.
Add _chat_enabled tests: False for 'requested','accepted','rejected','cancelled','closed'; True for every status in CHAT_STATUSES ('confirmed','collected','disputed').
Add _is_admin tests: True only when claims['cognito:groups'] contains 'admins'; False for an empty list, a missing claim, and an unrelated group.
Extend the public_view tests (or add one) to assert priceType/maxPrice/currency are present while the non-owner address stays masked (preserve the existing masking assertions).
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_collect.py imports lambdas/collect/app.py via the existing _load() helper and all new tests reference real functions.
The _creq_view tests assert both the absence of contact fields pre-confirm and the presence of the always-exposed price fields (NIT#6), plus the waste=None call-site contract.
The full suite — existing + new — passes with 'pytest -q'.
No test requires AWS/network (pure functions only, under the conftest.py stubs).
verification: From the worktree root run 'pip install -r requirements-dev.txt' then 'pytest -q' and confirm every test (existing and new) passes.
Run 'pytest tests/test_collect.py -q' and confirm the new _dec_price/_validate_quote/_creq_view/_chat_enabled/_is_admin/public_view tests are collected and green.
findings: Added pure-function unit tests to tests/test_collect.py (now 25 tests, all green). Coverage: _dec_price (parse+2dp round via quantize HALF_EVEN e.g. '1.555'->1.56; blank/None/junk/multi-dot -> None; negative -> None); _validate_quote (None/0/negative -> (False,'A quote amount greater than 0 is required'); above-max -> (False,"Quote exceeds the owner's maximum price"); within-max and no-max -> (True,None)); _creq_view (renamed test_creq_view_unlocks_when_approved -> ...when_confirmed; NIT#6 price fields quoteAmount/currency/maxPrice/paymentStatus ALWAYS present pre-confirm with contact absent; unlock loop over UNLOCK_STATUSES ('confirmed','collected','disputed') with a waste object asserts unlocked+fullAddress+ownerPhone; waste=None loop asserts contact absent — list_requests call-site contract); _chat_enabled (False for requested/accepted/rejected/cancelled/closed; True for every CHAT_STATUSES status); _is_admin (True only when 'admins' in cognito:groups; False for empty list/missing claim/unrelated group); public_view extended to assert priceType/currency/maxPrice exposed to non-owner while address stays masked. No app.py changes needed — all FEAT-002/FEAT-003 functions behaved correctly, suite passes with 'pytest -q' (full suite + file-level 25 collected).
